thread:
Liv: FYI - saw a cluster of partial-response + client-side timeout errors on /v1/stream at 2026-03-20 18:27 UTC. Attaching quick summary and want to lock owners for remediation.
Arjun: Can you paste the error IDs? I'll correlate with traces.
Liv: error ids: rinf-err-8812, rinf-err-8813, rinf-err-8814. Also saw increased heartbeat misses from clients around 18:25-18:30.
Maria: recurring pattern: we've hit similar client heartbeat drops twice in the last 6 weeks during rolling deploys. Likely interplay between connection drain + aggressive client backoff.
Kai: Agree. Hypothesis: server-side drain causes TCP FIN earlier, clients backoff then re-open causing partial streams or timeout. Need graceful resync / handshake adjustments.
Arjun: Proposed short-term actions:
- Increase server drain grace to 10s (was 2s) — owner: @Kai — due EOD tomorrow
- Add explicit SSE/WS 'resync' handshake on reconnect to request missing tokens — owner: @Maria — due in 3 days
- Add a telemetry flag for 'partial_chunk=true' in logs — owner: @Liv — due EOD today
Liv: I'll add the telemetry PR and a quick dashboard to show partial vs full responses. Linking ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RINF-1887
ops-bot: Created ticket RINF-1887 for telemetry + dashboard (assignee: Liv).
Kai: For the drain grace change, I'll put a canary patch on staging now. Deploy bot will post updates.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary deployment to staging started for service=runtime-streaming, tag=staging-drain-10s
Arjun: Long-term items we should track:
- Client SDK: implement incremental resume (client keeps chunk cursor and requests missing tokens) — owner: @Maria — scope: SDK 1.4
- Server: add explicit reconnect policy and surface reason codes to clients (e.g., DRAIN, BACKPRESSURE, NETWORK) — owner: @Kai — RFC by next Tues
- SLO: add SLA alert for partial-response rate > 0.5% over 5m — owner: SRE (Arjun) — config by Friday
Maria: I can prototype incremental resume in the JS SDK; will open PR with tests. ETA 2 weeks.
Liv: Can we capture correlating data: rolling deploy windows, kube reschedule events, and client version distribution during spikes? That will help root cause vs client bug.
Arjun: I'll query tracing:span and infra events and attach a short timeline to the ticket once canary runs. Also will add a recurring postmortem revisit in two weeks to see if pattern recurs.
Kai: If canary looks good, I'll roll drain change to 50% of prod traffic overnight with fast rollback window.
Maria: Quick snippet for client exponential backoff we should standardize in SDKs:
```
const retry = (attempt) => Math.min(1000 * 2 ** attempt, 30000) + jitter()
```
Liv: Action tracker summary (I'll paste into RINF-1887):
- Liv: telemetry + dashboard — due today
- Kai: staging canary for drain grace and RFC for reconnect codes — canary now, RFC next Tue
- Maria: SDK incremental resume prototype — 2 weeks
- Arjun: SLO/alerting config + timeline correlation — due Fri
Follow-up meeting: Thu 09:00 UTC to review canary metrics and dashboard. If nothing spikes, close short-term items; otherwise escalate.
Arjun: I'll own the postmortem revisit recurrence (biweekly) and invite SRE + SDK leads.
Liv: Thanks all. Adding meeting invite and will update the ticket with the action table. :white_check_mark:
